generator.reference_note: Deliberately empty. The brand library is hanger shots with flat multi-colour vector graphics — the exact look being replaced. Passing them as references drags output back toward it.

style_template: Overhead product photograph of one {COLOR} cotton t-shirt laid flat on {SURFACE}, shot straight down on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, sharp focus, {LIGHT} with natural falloff and soft real shadows inside the fabric folds. Real garment: visible cotton weave texture, natural wrinkles and creases, ribbed collar, stitched hems. Centered on the chest is a heat-pressed vinyl transfer printed in one single flat {INK} tone only: {GRAPHIC}. The print sits on top of the fabric and follows its wrinkles and weave, with a slight matte vinyl sheen and softly creased edges. No gradients, no shading and no fine detail inside the print. Nothing else in frame: no hangtags, no neck labels, no logos, no watermarks, no props, no other text.

pieces.name: Ember 01
pieces.LIGHT: soft directional light from one side
pieces.GRAPHIC: a winged dagger badge. The dagger is seen from the side and points straight DOWN — a long narrow blade tapering to a sharp point at the bottom, a short handle and a small round pommel at the top — and a pair of small outstretched feathered wings spread horizontally to the left and right from the top of the handle. It must read as a knife with wings, NOT as a cross, crucifix or plus sign. Below the badge is short serif text reading "ONE OF THIRTY"
